description: This file defines the PolicyId class which provides an immutable, uniquely identifiable, and utility-based implementation for policy identifiers within the Eclipse Ditto project. It includes methods for creating and managing policy IDs, handling invalid cases, and representing the ID as strings.

classes.name: PolicyId
classes.description: An immutable Java representation of a policy identifier, offering static factory methods for creation, validation, and dummy ID retrieval. Implements NamespacedEntityId and overrides equality and string representation methods.

methods.name: of (CharSequence)
methods.description: Creates or returns a PolicyId from a given CharSequence, bypassing validation if input is already a PolicyId.

methods.name: of (String, String)
methods.description: Creates a PolicyId with specified namespace and policy name.

methods.name: inNamespaceWithRandomName
methods.description: Generates a PolicyId with a random UUID as the name within the specified namespace.

methods.name: wrapInPolicyIdInvalidException
methods.description: Executes a supplier to create a PolicyId, wrapping any NamespacedEntityIdInvalidException in a custom PolicyIdInvalidException.

methods.name: dummy
methods.description: Returns a singleton dummy PolicyId that should not be used for actual identification.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name component of the policy ID.

methods.name: getNamespace
methods.description: Returns the namespace component of the policy ID.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks equality based on the underlying NamespacedEntityId.

methods.name: hashCode
methods.description: Generates a hash code based on the entityId field.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of the entityId.

methods.name: isDummy
methods.description: Determines if the PolicyId is the dummy singleton.
